name: residual_table_cell_crosscheck
reason: MuPDF sort=True interleaves wrapped table-header lines. Both complete pages and the MuPDF geometric cell tables were inspected; original expected dates are unchanged. The flattened-text failure remains preserved.
method: Read the actual grid cells with PyMuPDF find_tables; require the six exact normalized labels, one A-share row, last-trading dash, physical cell boxes and all four date cells agreeing with the preregistered expectations. Check all twelve cells on each repeated table. Do not infer a field from unlabelled date order.
scope: This is an independent layout check, not acceptance of event facts or a production parser change. All other source regression checks must still pass; any unexplained failure blocks closure.
